abstract: Maintains environmental standards certification and green audit records
system_message:
You are the Environmental sustainability auditor (ENV), responsible for maintaining environmental standards certification and green audit records across candidate venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains environmental standards certification and green audit records（CERT）
information_points.content:
ENV-CERT-CLZ：According to the current facility building lifecycle audit in the sustainable venue registry, Aethelgard Waterfront Expo Centre holds certified green building status based on valid Gold or Platinum eco-design certification.
ENV-CERT-QGU：Based on the sustainable venue registry's current facility building lifecycle audit, Highland Riverside Congress Hub does not hold certified green building status, lacking valid Gold or Platinum eco-design certification.
ENV-CERT-689：The sustainable venue registry confirms that Vanguard Metropolitan Concourse possesses certified green building status under its current facility building lifecycle audit with valid Gold or Platinum eco-design certification.

information_points.title: On-site renewable generation（SOLAR）
information_points.content:
ENV-SOLAR-9Q9：The energy audit certificate indicates that Vanguard Metropolitan Concourse features a grid-tied rooftop solar array providing an installed rooftop solar photovoltaic capacity of 400 kW peak power generation output.
ENV-SOLAR-B4S：Highland Riverside Congress Hub maintains a grid-tied rooftop solar array with an installed rooftop solar photovoltaic capacity of 550 kW peak power output per its energy audit certificate.
ENV-SOLAR-NF9：According to the energy audit certificate, Aethelgard Waterfront Expo Centre has an installed rooftop solar photovoltaic capacity of 250 kW peak power generation output on its grid-tied rooftop solar array.
